极其简化的 SDXL 工作流程

一个干净、严肃的 SDXL 工作流程，专为那些想要结果而无需与节点图作斗争的人而构建。无论您是 ComfyUI 的新手还是只是厌倦了臃肿的工作流程，这都可以让您快速生成。所有重要的内容都在 APP 模式中显现 - 提示、模型、采样器设置、分辨率和 LoRA。其他一切都不妨碍您。

这是给谁的？

- ComfyUI初学者想要一个坚实的起点而又不被淹没的人

- 不废话的用户只想点击生成并获得好图像的人

- 低 VRAM 用户- 在整个工作流程中放置积极的 GPU 内存清理节点，以保持稳定

- 如果您曾经打开过一个“简单”的工作流程并发现有 200 个节点在盯着您，那么这就是解药

显存要求

|显存 |经验|

|---|---|

| 8GB|合适 - 清理节点有助于保持稳定 |

| 12GB|推荐甜蜜点|

| 16 GB+ |流畅，不妥协 |

该工作流程在各个通道之间使用专用的 VRAM 清理节点，因此即使是低端卡也可以完成完整的两通道管道，而不会耗尽内存。

包含什么

- 两遍生成具有内置的招聘修复（第一次通过+高档/细化）

- rg三KSampler配置- 设置步骤、CFG、采样器和调度程序一次，自动应用于两个通道

- 劳拉装载机堆栈带 4 个 LoRA 插槽

- SAM + bbox 探测器第二遍（自动主体检测和细节）

- 分辨率选择器具有适当的 SDXL 宽高比和内置百万像素缩放

- CLIPSetLastLayer 位于 -2用于更清洁的空调

- GPU内存清理通道之间的节点，这样 VRAM 就不会被活活吃掉

- 你只看到最终结果- 第一次预览是故意隐藏的，以保持干净
- 细节设计器预先调整了平衡设置，应该适合绝大多数用户。如果您发现结果不太符合您的喜好，则需要切换到工作流程模式并手动调整详细节点 - 也就是说，我选择的默认值应该足以满足 90% 的用例。

这背后的工作

这个工作流程几乎经历了4 小时的测试、调整和迭代在简单性和输出质量之间找到适当的平衡。每个节点放置、每个清理点和每个默认设置都是经过精心选择的。我们的目标是构建一个初学者可以立即掌握的东西，但不会在重要的事情上偷工减料。

所需的自定义节点

通过安装这些舒适UI管理器加载工作流程之前：

- rg三舒适

- ComfyUI 易于使用

- ComfyUI 影响包

所需型号

bbox 检测器（用于细节/第二遍）

工作流程使用Eyeful_v2-Paired.pt作为默认的 bbox 检测器。默认情况下，Impact Pack 不包含此内容。

在这里下载：

👉Eyeful_v2_paired

安装：

1. 下载Eyeful_v2-Paired.pt（或任何其他.pt您喜欢的 bbox 模型）

2. 将其放入：ComfyUI/模型/ultralytics/bbox/

3.如果文件夹不存在则创建

4. 重新启动 ComfyUI - 它将自动出现在模型下拉列表中

> 您可以将其替换为 adetailer 系列中的任何其他 bbox 模型，例如脸_yolov8m.pt或手_yolov8s.pt- 相同的安装位置。

默认设置

|设置|价值|

|---|---|

|第一步 | 30|

|雇用修复步骤| 15 | 15

| CFG | 4.5 | 4.5

|采样器|欧拉|

|调度程序|简单|

|分辨率| 1344x768（16:9@1MP）|

从线性模式面板更改其中任何一个，而无需触摸图形。

专为那些知道自己想要生成什么的人而设计，而不是那些想花 2 小时连接节点的人。

o.en:
Extremely Simplified SDXL Workflow

A clean, no-nonsense SDXL workflow built for people who want results without fighting their node graph. Whether you are brand new to ComfyUI or just tired of bloated workflows, this gets you generating fast. Everything that matters is surfaced in APP Mode - prompts, model, sampler settings, resolution, and LoRAs. Everything else stays out of your way.

Who Is This For?

- ComfyUI beginnerswho want a solid starting point without being overwhelmed

- No-nonsense userswho just want to hit generate and get a good image

- Low VRAM users- aggressive GPU memory cleanup nodes are placed throughout the workflow to keep things stable

- If you have ever opened a "simple" workflow and found 200 nodes staring back at you, this is the antidote

VRAM Requirements

| VRAM | Experience |

|---|---|

| 8 GB | Suitable - cleanup nodes help keep it stable |

| 12 GB | Recommended sweet spot |

| 16 GB+ | Smooth, no compromises |

The workflow uses dedicated VRAM cleanup nodes between passes so even lower-end cards can get through the full two-pass pipeline without running out of memory.

What's Included

- Two-pass generationwith a built-in hires fix (first pass + upscale/refine)

- rgthree KSampler Config- set steps, CFG, sampler, and scheduler once, applies to both passes automatically

- Lora Loader Stackwith 4 LoRA slots

- SAM + bbox detectorfor the second pass (automatic subject detection and detailing)

- Resolution Selectorwith proper SDXL aspect ratios and megapixel scaling built in

- CLIPSetLastLayer at -2for cleaner conditioning

- GPU memory cleanupnodes between passes so VRAM does not get eaten alive

- You only see thefinal result- the first pass preview is intentional and hidden to keep things clean
- The detailers come pre-tuned with balanced settings that should work well for the vast majority of users. If you find the results are not quite to your liking, you will need to switch to workflow mode and adjust the detailer nodes manually - that said, the defaults I chose should be more than sufficient for 90% of use cases.

The Work Behind This

This workflow went through nearly4 hours of testing, tweaking, and iterationto find the right balance between simplicity and output quality. Every node placement, every cleanup point, and every default setting was chosen deliberately. The goal was to build something that a beginner can pick up instantly but that does not cut corners on what matters.

Required Custom Nodes

Install these viaComfyUI Managerbefore loading the workflow:

- rgthree-comfy

- ComfyUI Easy Use

- ComfyUI Impact Pack

Required Models

bbox Detector (for the detailer/second pass)

The workflow usesEyeful_v2-Paired.ptas the default bbox detector. This is NOT included with Impact Pack by default.

Download it here:

👉Eyeful_v2_paired

Installation:

1. DownloadEyeful_v2-Paired.pt(or any other.ptbbox model you prefer)

2. Place it in:ComfyUI/models/ultralytics/bbox/

3. Create the folder if it does not exist

4. Restart ComfyUI - it will appear in the model dropdown automatically

> You can swap it for any other bbox model from the adetailer collection such asface_yolov8m.ptorhand_yolov8s.pt- same install location.

Default Settings

| Setting | Value |

|---|---|

| First Pass Steps | 30 |

| Hires Fix Steps | 15 |

| CFG | 4.5 |

| Sampler | Euler |

| Scheduler | Simple |

| Resolution | 1344x768 (16:9 @ 1MP) |

Change any of it from the Linear Mode panel without touching the graph.

Designed for people who know what they want to generate, not people who want to spend 2 hours wiring nodes.
